INS Mahendragiri Stealth Frigate to Join Indian Navy Fleet

The Indian Navy is set to commission the INS Mahendragiri, its sixth stealth frigate, into its fleet on July 11. The warship is described as being equipped with an advanced suite of weapons and sensors, enhancing the navy's capabilities.
